title: Western Digital, Micron, Sandisk hover at all-time highs as AI trade reignites

title: French startup bets on non-humanoid design in crowded AI robot race
title_zh: 法国初创公司在拥挤的人工智能机器人竞赛中押注非人形设计
summary: Genesis AI, the French robotics startup backed by former Google CEO Eric Schmidt, unveiled ‌its first general-purpose robot on Tuesday, as AI capabilities expand beyond chatbots and ‌into physical machines.
summary_zh: 由谷歌前首席执行官埃里克·施密特 (Eric Sc​​hmidt) 支持的法国机器人初创公司 Genesis AI 于周二推出了其首款通用机器人，人工智能功能已从聊天机器人扩展到物理机器。

title: India's Bigbasket names former Amazon veteran Amit Nanda as CEO

summary: BANGALORE, June 16 - Indian online grocery retailer Bigbasket on Tuesday appointed Amit Nanda as its CEO, replacing co-founder Hari Menon, who will continue to serve on the board.
summary_zh: 班加罗尔，6 月 16 日 - 印度在线杂货零售商 Bigbasket 周二任命 Amit Nanda 为其首席执行官，接替联合创始人 Hari Menon，后者将继续担任董事会成员。
